# Replicating PNC pilot

Anne's previous SNF analyses in the PNC dataset identified three subtypes.
Subtype #3 was found to have a significantly higher proportion of children that experienced LOC following their injuries, significantly poorer outcomes on the line orientation test (a measure of visuospatial processing), and significantly lower functional connectivity between the brainstem and occipital cortex.



```{r echo = FALSE, out.width = "70%", message = FALSE}
library(here)
library(knitr)
knitr::include_graphics(here("figures/abcd/pnc_aw.png"))
```


There is no equivalent assessment of the line orientation test in the ABCD dataset.

Within the available rs-fMRI parcellations, the occipital cortex is best captured by the Gordon parcellation "visual network" and the brainstem is best captured by the ASEG parcellation "brain-stem".

The variable of interest is `rsfmri_cor_ngd_vs_scs_bs` (the average correlation between these two regions).

```{r}

library(abcdutils)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

# Import baseline TBI data
mtbi_detailed <- read_delim(here("data/abcd/misc/mtbi_detailed.csv"))

# Import rsfmri data
rm_subc_cor <-
    read_delim(here("data/abcd/inputs/pre-imputation/rm_subc_cor.csv"))

# Patten comparison processing speed
nihtbx_pattern_fc <-
    read_delim(here("data/abcd/outputs/pre-imputation/nihtbx_pattern_fc.csv"))


association_df <-
    dplyr::inner_join(mtbi_detailed, rm_subc_cor, by = "subjectkey") |>
    dplyr::select("subjectkey",
                  "latest_mtbi_loc",
                  "rsfmri_cor_ngd_vs_scs_bs") |>
    dplyr::inner_join(nihtbx_pattern_fc, by = "subjectkey")

association_df$latest_mtbi_loc[association_df$latest_mtbi_loc == 0] <-
    "no LOC"

association_df$latest_mtbi_loc[association_df$latest_mtbi_loc == 1] <-
    "LOC between 0 and 30 mins"

association_df$latest_mtbi_loc <- factor(association_df$latest_mtbi_loc,
    levels = c("no LOC", "LOC between 0 and 30 mins"))


t_tester <- function(df, output, input, cond1, cond2) {
   group1 <- df[, output][df[, input] == cond1]
   group2 <- df[, output][df[, input] == cond2]
   results <- t.test(group1, group2)$p.value
   return(results)
}



# RSFC VS. LOC ================================================================
ggplot(association_df,
       mapping = aes(x = latest_mtbi_loc,
                     y = rsfmri_cor_ngd_vs_scs_bs,
                     color = latest_mtbi_loc)) +
    scale_color_hue(direction = -1) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 24)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_jitter()
# Appears to be more variability in the group that did have LOC

ggsave(here("figures/abcd/rsfmri_cor_occipital_bs_vs_loc.png"),
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)

t_tester(association_df,
         output = "rsfmri_cor_ngd_vs_scs_bs",
         input = "latest_mtbi_loc",
         cond1 = "no LOC",
         cond2 = "LOC between 0 and 30 mins")
# p = 0.44


# PATTERN PROCESSING SPEED VS. LOC ============================================
ggplot(association_df,
       mapping = aes(x = latest_mtbi_loc,
                     y = nihtbx_pattern_fc,
                     color = latest_mtbi_loc)) +
    scale_color_hue(direction = -1) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 24)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_jitter()
# Appears to be more variability in the group that did have LOC

t_tester(association_df,
         output = "nihtbx_pattern_fc",
         input = "latest_mtbi_loc",
         cond1 = "no LOC",
         cond2 = "LOC between 0 and 30 mins")
# p = 0.48

ggsave(here("figures/abcd/nihtbx_pattern_fc_vs_loc.png"),
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)


# RSFC VS PATTERN PROCESSING SPEED ============================================
ggplot(association_df, mapping = aes_string(x = "nihtbx_pattern_fc",
                                            y = "rsfmri_cor_ngd_vs_scs_bs")) +
    geom_point() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 24)) +
    geom_smooth(method = lm, se = TRUE)

cor.test(association_df$nihtbx_pattern_fc,
         association_df$rsfmri_cor_ngd_vs_scs_bs,
         use = "complete.obs")$p.value
# p = 0.27

ggsave(here("figures/abcd/rsfmri_cor_occipital_bs_vs_nihtbx_pattern_fc.png"),
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```
